requirements.title: Canonical USL Semantic IR
requirements.contract: Canonical typed value/control/call/workflow/resource/evidence/policy/transformation/verification/audit nodes carry IDs, typed inputs/outputs, capabilities, effects and source locations. Unsupported executable semantics are explicit; development guidance is not production implementation.
requirements.remaining: The four-part production expression is necessary, not sufficient for the user’s full-standard conformance and intent proof requirement. Finite tests do not establish universal semantic equivalence.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Extend the existing typed IR with versioned workflow/resource/evidence node schemas and source spans; independently validate effects and required capabilities, then lower through registered native handlers. Add source→IR→target observational tests per supported profile.

requirements.title: Work Graphs
requirements.contract: Work and resource graphs are distinct. Nodes have durable dependency/state identity from operation, normalized input, environment, version and policy. Ready residual obligations, not requested worker totals, drive scheduling.
requirements.remaining: Define disjoint count bins: residual as all unresolved work would overlap running/blocked work. Failed/reused/superseded/cancelled states also need accounting; route outcome and lifecycle status should be separate axes.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Use durable DAG nodes with explicit state transitions, ready queues, dependency lineage, resumable verified coverage and invalidation. Validate missing edges/cycles and preserve node identities on restart.

requirements.title: Resource Graphs
requirements.contract: Advertise measured CPUs/GPUs/memory/storage/network/sensors/providers and costs/permissions on connecting paths. Match capabilities before vendor brands; include locality, transfer, energy and process ownership.
requirements.remaining: A discovered provider or device is not an executed native qualification. Unknown latency/energy/sensor health must stay unknown; brand names cannot fill missing measurements.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Wrap existing resource probes in timestamped typed nodes and permission-aware edges. Treat absent/unknown/blocked capabilities separately; intersect available capacity with actual container limits and owner budgets.

requirements.title: Physical and Logical Resource Accounting
requirements.contract: Separate measured physical capacity from logical requests/workers/virtual views/reconstructed references/shared mappings. Avoided work and throughput gains are never extra installed cores or RAM.
requirements.remaining: OS logical processors are hardware-topology views, distinct from logical work factors. AvoidedWork subtraction is valid only for equivalent baseline execution units; verification/extra retries can make naive counts misleading.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Add distinct physical.*, effective_limits.*, logical.*, execution.* and reuse.* telemetry namespaces with units, source, timestamps and unknown flags; test that dashboards cannot relabel logical counts as hardware.

requirements.title: USL Resource Algebra
requirements.contract: Every logical request has an accounted outcome. Optimize over correctness-, integrity-, QoS- and policy-feasible plans using a vector of time/compute/memory/I/O/energy/price costs.
requirements.remaining: The W_physical equation mixes task counts and costs unless converted to a declared common work-equivalent unit. Weighting energy, bytes, seconds and price requires explicit conversion weights or a Pareto policy.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Record disjoint route outcomes and per-phase cost vectors; implement feasibility before ranking. Expose a declared policy objective with typed units instead of a magic scalar score.

requirements.title: Exact Collapse and Content Addressability
requirements.contract: Collapse immutable content only within an explicit semantic identity domain; hashes index evidence and content/metadata integrity still gets checked. Mutable equal bytes do not imply shareable identity; snapshots and rollback references constrain reclamation.
requirements.remaining: Digest equality is not a mathematical collision-free proof. StorageSaved must separate logical uncompressed size, physical encoded bytes, metadata and retained snapshots; side effects and mutable owners cannot be deduplicated by bytes.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Extend exact CAS keys with specification, implementation, runtime/dependency, policy and platform identities; verify objects on read, quarantine corruption, track owners/snapshots and retain rollback roots before GC.

requirements.title: Memoization and Verified Reuse
requirements.contract: Keys include every observable input, semantic operation, runtime/model/environment and policy flag. Byte-exact, semantic-exact, tolerance-, freshness- and user-approved reuse are separate levels that cannot silently weaken.
requirements.remaining: A high hit ratio can have negative net benefit. Explicit freshness is required for time-sensitive outputs; external actions must not be replayed or skipped simply because earlier request bytes match.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Add typed reuse modes and obligation validators; retain miss/invalidation/verification-cost counters and nonzero-denominator rules. Re-execute nondeterministic or effectful operations unless an explicit admissible evidence contract permits otherwise.

requirements.title: Delta and Residual Computation
requirements.contract: Delta changes a verified base; residual identifies unresolved obligations. Incremental execution falls back to broader recomputation when completeness of the delta cannot be verified.
requirements.remaining: H0/H1/H2 labels are implementation-specific and not defined in this volume; do not equate them with these concepts by name alone. General semantic differences cannot be inferred from textual diffs.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Extend existing incremental H0/H1/H2 integration with base digests, operation versions, complete dependency invalidation and domain-specific coverage differences. Differentially compare incremental and full results, including deletion and changed dependencies.

requirements.title: Reconstruction
requirements.contract: Evict only reproducible derived state whose authoritative inputs, versioned operation/environment and verification rule remain available. Materialized objects still consume physical memory.
requirements.remaining: Bytes minus compute cost requires an explicit conversion policy. Resident bytes and recipe/reference counts cannot be added as one capacity number; keep resident bytes, backed bytes and recipe counts separate.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Create reconstruction recipes rooted in retained immutable inputs; estimate latency/cost, enforce output integrity after materialization and prioritize eviction of derivable over irreplaceable state.

requirements.title: Backing, Spill, and State Migration
requirements.contract: Hot RAM/VRAM, warm mmap and cold storage tiers preserve logical references through verified migration. Old authoritative copies remain until the destination and reference commit are verified.
requirements.remaining: SSD-backed state is not DRAM-equivalent. RAM/VRAM sharing and double counting need platform-aware identities; remote/object-store paths require credentials/policy and actual acceptance tests.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Implement a transactional local-store spill/mmap prototype: staging file, digest verification, atomic reference swap, durable recovery journal and release-after-commit. Record cold/warm latency and bytes moved.

requirements.title: Heterogeneous CPU, GPU, and Accelerator Routing
requirements.contract: Route only to real supported operation/dtype/provider combinations, including transfer, residency, queueing and verification costs. Invalidate preferences after relevant hardware/version/thermal/workload changes.
requirements.remaining: No GPU or accelerator equivalence follows from a CPU implementation. ONNX tolerance must be domain-specific; 1e-5 in the example is not a universal correctness threshold.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Register CPU and discovered accelerator providers with supported operations, shapes and measured route costs; benchmark end-to-end cold/warm paths and retain negative results. Require provider execution evidence before marking GPU qualified.

requirements.title: Partial and Factored Workers
requirements.contract: Factor work by tiles/ranges/partitions/stages/dimensions/residuals and stop recursive decomposition when overhead wins. Logical factors and OS threads/cores are separate.
requirements.remaining: Fractal means recursive algorithmic decomposition, not extra hardware or automatic intelligence. Benefits/costs need common units and measured workload baselines; more logical workers can be slower.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Use existing factored/fractal workers with concrete dependency partitions, exact CAS-compatible shared intermediates, measured coordinator costs and admission ceilings. Preserve task coverage and correctness under serial and concurrent scheduling.

requirements.title: Adaptive Worker Admission
requirements.contract: Queued and admitted work differ; admission budgets memory/descriptors/cache/device queues/latency. Observe throughput and p95/p99 pressure; expand cautiously and contract quickly.
requirements.remaining: A rejected upper candidate does not bracket a global optimum without monotonicity and stationary conditions. Label the measured admissible interval, not an unproved optimal admission bound.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Add hysteresis, bounded exploration, cooldown, pressure backoff and a durable record of tested admissions to existing adaptive workers. Include fairness and cancellation, and reserve foreground demand.

requirements.title: Quality of Service and Resource Pressure
requirements.contract: Foreground/high-priority work supersedes opportunistic jobs. Contracts specify latency/throughput/deadline/jitter/availability/interference; failures require a declared degraded mode, backoff or rejection.
requirements.remaining: Opportunity is a resource vector, not a cross-unit scalar. Available/reserved/demand terms must avoid double counting. Unknown interactive/thermal state is not zero demand or a passed safety gate.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Build per-resource pressure/QoS guards using actual CPU, memory, I/O, GPU, thermal and battery probes when available. Make missing metrics explicit and impose owner ceilings; report sample windows and p95/p99 methods.

requirements.title: Cross-Resource Transformations
requirements.contract: Transforms declare source/target roles, preconditions, costs, proof obligations and reversal/fallback. Reconstruction, backing, sharing and verified reuse change how a requirement is satisfied, not physical laws.
requirements.remaining: A role substitution is not a physical resource conversion. Network fetch and storage backing incur real latency/permissions; reconstructing state still requires eventual materialization memory.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Create a versioned transformation registry linked to exact CAS, reconstruction, spill and immutable mapping handlers; validate obligations before selecting a transformed plan and record rejected branches.

requirements.title: Shared Models, KV, and Immutable State
requirements.contract: Share verified immutable weights/tokenizers/constants/read-only segments with explicit host scope and lifetimes; isolate request-specific mutable KV state and consider model residency in routes.
requirements.remaining: Mapping one file does not prove one physical RAM/VRAM copy; page residency must be measured. KV sharing is model/backend-specific and requires actual model fixtures and privacy isolation tests.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Use digest-pinned mmap/read-only weights and model descriptors shared by workers, with retained references and actual resident/backing-byte telemetry. Key KV prefixes by model/tokenizer/positions/attention/configuration and security scope.

requirements.title: Causal Debt
requirements.contract: Durable debt tokens record claim, missing evidence, affected nodes, creation time, severity and discharge rule. Speculation remains provisional; debt discharges only after evidence and revalidation/invalidation of dependants.
requirements.remaining: The addition is a union/accounting shorthand, not a scalar physics quantity. Debt zero is necessary, not sufficient for correctness. Elapsed time, model confidence and lease expiry do not discharge evidence obligations.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Attach typed obligation sets to graph nodes and output evidence; propagate through dependency lineage, invalidate affected descendants on evidence changes and block verified/promotion states while debt remains.

requirements.title: Temporal Work Graphs
requirements.contract: Distinguish event, observation and version time plus validity intervals. Preserve immutable observed history; predictions carry model/version/confidence; late evidence revises provisional descendants with lineage.
requirements.remaining: Predicted and observed values need tagged types even when bytes match. Distributed clock alignment and real-time sensor validity require measured clock/calibration error; abstract unions do not solve causality.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Add bitemporal/valid-time event records, monotonic sequence IDs, versioned derived/predicted nodes and targeted recomputation. Test late/out-of-order observations, timestamp skew and restart continuity.

requirements.title: Autoplastic Runtime Adaptation
requirements.contract: Adapt scheduler/cache/route/chunk/prefetch strategy inside immutable security/truth/correctness/owner limits. Proposals include expected benefit, scope, evidence, rollback state and trial duration; promotion is gated.
requirements.remaining: The plus sign denotes a configuration update, not numeric addition. Adaptive strategies cannot grant permissions, change semantic versions or weaken the user’s accepted objective.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Implement staged candidate configurations, canary trials, independent holdout/regression checks, durable rollback pointers and automatic rejection on gate failure. Reuse existing tested skill/model promotion patterns for runtime parameters.

requirements.title: Learn to Instruct to Learn
requirements.contract: Learn reality, encode a concrete semantic rule/test/template/policy/remediation, run it and retain what passed/failed/remains unknown. Guidance or a placeholder is not a healed implementation.
requirements.remaining: Knowledge retrieval, learning a program and updating weights are distinct. General language/AI competence does not follow from a small verified rule family or an LLM’s own proposed answer.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Connect entity self-study to a gap ledger, traceable source records, explicit hypotheses, independently specified tests and versioned candidate promotion. Retain rejected observations and invalidate assumptions without deleting lineage.

requirements.title: Self-Diagnosis and Self-Repair
requirements.contract: Gather symptoms/change/log/dependency/resource/probe evidence before a bounded repair. Quarantine corrupted cache, rebuild derived state, restart isolated workers or revert known configurations within actual capabilities.
requirements.remaining: Reproducible diagnosis can remain unknown; no permission bypass, invented authoritative data or silent owner-policy changes. Hardware faults and missing model assets cannot be repaired by metadata alone.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Add deterministic repair playbooks with evidence predicates and reversible actions; regression-test recovered invariants and record attempt/failure/provenance. Separate authoritative from safely rebuildable derived state.

requirements.title: Verification and Proof Obligations
requirements.contract: Declare byte/semantic/tolerance/order/freshness/confidentiality/QoS/domain invariants before optimization. Retain hashes, replay/property/reference/dual-execution/type/signature/domain evidence; failed optimized output is rejected and failed branches retained.
requirements.remaining: Hashes establish integrity, not original intent or general semantics. Typechecks, test cases and bounded SMT models have distinct scopes; solver unknowns and unsupported operations must not be reported as proof.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Create independent obligation validators with PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN/BLOCKED results; fail closed on required unknowns and separate fallback success from optimization success. Link exact runtime/source/implementation identities to evidence.

requirements.title: Rollback and Transactional Mutation
requirements.contract: Stage mutations outside active state, validate and atomically commit where possible. Durably retain sufficient rollback state before change; use explicit compensation/idempotency for external effects.
requirements.remaining: Idempotency plus durable local intent does not universally guarantee exactly-once effects. Remote hosts must support the key/fencing or compensation; uncertain effects require reconciliation, not blind retry.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Use a durable prepare/commit/rollback journal and content-addressed snapshots for configurations/artifacts; recover interrupted candidates without automatically replaying external actions. Retain effect intent, idempotency key, acknowledgement and uncertainty state.

requirements.title: Persistent Runtime Evidence
requirements.contract: Store environment/workload/decision/measurements/verification/timestamp/expiry/version records. Valid evidence guides heuristics but cannot redefine language semantics, keywords, physical reporting or permissions.
requirements.remaining: Benchmark priors are workload-specific and decay; aggregate confidence is not a mandatory override. User-controlled system time needs explicit monotonic/UTC validity handling.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Extend the durable evidence store with typed scope, expiry and dependency invalidation; index workload shapes and route/admission histories. Revalidate against current runtime/specification/configuration identities before reuse.

requirements.title: Shadow Integration
requirements.contract: Shadow is an optional planning/admin client above independently executable USL. Proposals and conversational mutations pass deterministic syntax/semantic/capability/owner gates; read-only queries stay distinct.
requirements.remaining: An installed adapter is not live model inference. No model may infer authorization or grant itself capabilities; the book is not authority to send messages, mutate external systems or install elevated services.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Bind existing Shadow/Ollama proposal adapters to typed workflows and evidence queries; keep proposed source inert until validation and actual capability admission. Test hostile/unresolved/incorrect proposals and retain explanation/provenance.

requirements.title: Sensors and Multimodal Resources
requirements.contract: Advertise modality/rate/resolution/calibration/timestamps/permissions/health. Derived fusion retains source provenance and temporal alignment; acquisition and use both require capabilities.
requirements.remaining: Real cameras/microphones/IMUs/chemical/touch sensors and calibration assets are required for live qualification. Synthetic fixtures/fusion output do not establish physical devices, human sensation or sensory equivalence.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Connect existing typed sensor packets/adapters to resource nodes and calibration/time-validity obligations; distinguish live/recorded/synthetic/derived modes. Add dropouts, stale calibration, skew and contradictory-stream acceptance cases.

requirements.title: Edge and Embedded USL
requirements.contract: Declare host/edge/embedded semantic profiles and flash/RAM/timing/energy/I/O budgets. Omitting JIT/large registries/network is a declared profile, not a silently different language; offline bundles preserve integrity.
requirements.remaining: The example 128KiB budget is a requested limit, not evidence Python USL fits it. Native MCU binaries, measured peak RAM and real-time deadlines require a target toolchain and hardware qualification.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Define an explicit deterministic embedded feature matrix, resource-budget report and pinned offline package manifest. Qualify packaging/determinism on a real target or emulator whose limitations are recorded.

requirements.title: Distributed USL Fabrics
requirements.contract: Nodes have authenticated identities, owner scopes, advertised capabilities and health. Use durable work identity, leases/checkpoints/idempotency and locality to survive failures without silent duplicate side effects.
requirements.remaining: A single-machine process pool is not distributed host qualification. Failure risk and bytes/latency costs need declared units; expired leases cannot trigger automatic external-effect replay without reconciliation.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Extend existing mesh/cooperative workers with authenticated advertisements, fenced leases, durable assignments and locality-aware CAS transfer. Exercise node loss, late results, duplicated messages, corruption and ownership boundaries.

requirements.title: Windows Runtime
requirements.contract: Use documented Windows process/filesystem/service/token/resource/GPU APIs with a user-profile installation and optional isolated elevation. PowerShell is an owner launch/admin adapter, not a separate USL dialect.
requirements.remaining: This Linux environment cannot certify PowerShell, Windows tokens/services/process termination or GPU providers. OWNER.ps1 paths in the book are examples, not confirmed existing files or authority to elevate.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Add guarded platform probes and a reviewed owner launcher exposing doctor/validate/benchmark/start; keep portable core imports usable where POSIX resource APIs are absent. Run native Windows clean-install and lifecycle tests when a host is supplied.

requirements.title: Linux Runtime
requirements.contract: Keep parser/verifier/CAS/evidence/graphs portable while discovering procfs/sysfs/POSIX/cgroup and optional namespaces/epoll/io_uring/sensors/providers. Container constraints participate separately from host topology.
requirements.remaining: Do not assume namespaces/cgroups/io_uring access or fabricate host totals from container-visible values. The book’s python3 -m usl2 command differs from the current project package name.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Extend actual probes for cgroup v1/v2 quota/memory/cpuset, CPU affinity and known capacities; report unknowns and apply the minimum usable limit per resource. Validate process-group cancellation and current-user service ownership.

requirements.title: macOS Runtime
requirements.contract: Preserve SIR on Darwin/Apple Silicon with unified-memory identities, optional Metal/Core ML providers and appropriate signing/notarization for production distribution.
requirements.remaining: A Linux packaging check cannot certify Darwin APIs, Apple accelerators, unified-memory residency or notarization. Signing/notarization requires owner identity and an actual macOS release path.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Add platform-guarded resource/provider adapters and a shared-memory-pool ID in accounting; prepare smoke/upgrade/rollback procedures for a native macOS host.

requirements.title: Security and Capability Permissions
requirements.contract: Capabilities cover files/destinations/sensors/processes/install/model/elevated adapters; deny undelegated actions and keep secrets as protected references. Audit use without secret values.
requirements.remaining: The example deny network '*' plus allow one destination leaves precedence unspecified; define and test conflict resolution before execution. Static capabilities are not an OS sandbox, and book examples do not override current permissions.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Reuse explicit interpreter host capabilities with scoped file/network/device selectors and context checks; prevent adaptation from broadening authority. Validate redaction and capability inheritance/revocation.

requirements.title: Benchmark Science
requirements.contract: Declare hardware/software/corpus/seed/baseline/warm-cold/repetitions and unique inputs. Record physical executions, logical requests, verified hits, moved bytes, memory/utilization/correctness and slower results.
requirements.remaining: Zero denominators and insufficient tail samples need explicit outcomes. 256 requests over 32 unique inputs tests disclosed repeat-work reuse only; it is not a universal speedup or added hardware.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Extend existing benchmark reports with end-to-end phase costs, median/p95/p99, independent inputs, cold/warm labels and parameter/compute budgets. Require matching correctness before speedup calculation.

requirements.title: USL Equation Reference
requirements.contract: Collect accounting/scheduling/integrity equations as operational definitions with explicit terms, units, domains and validity conditions; reuse_ratio specifically requires denominator > 0.
requirements.remaining: Equations are a design reference, not physical conservation laws or completed algorithms. The book does not supply general proofs, benchmark data or algorithms for every formula.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Build a typed equation registry with canonical IDs, units, parameter validation and links to validators/evidence. Preserve documented aliases such as NetBenefit/NetReuseBenefit while rejecting dimensional errors.

requirements.title: USL Fabric Symbolic Reference
requirements.contract: Version resource directives fabric/discover/resource/capability/invariant/policy/route; work directives workflow/step/residual/execute/worker/admit/checkpoint/debt; optimization directives reuse/transform/share/reconstruct/adapt/verify/transaction/evidence/repair. Preserve existing symbolic/call/heal/audit meanings.
requirements.remaining: Current indentation-based .usl syntax does not parse these brace blocks. Cosmetic stripping, ignored directives or mapping unimplemented handlers to success would violate the book and the user’s request.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Introduce a separate versioned fabric frontend or explicit lowering adapter with registered field schemas and executable handlers; maintain profile capability matrices. Unknown directives fail with actionable unsupported diagnostics.

requirements.title: Production Deployment
requirements.contract: Build from a clean revision, dependency locks/SBOM/docs/test/benchmark metadata and applicable signatures. Native clean-install/upgrade/rollback/parser/semantics/discovery/smoke gates apply independently per OS; owner keeps canonical sources/keys/history.
requirements.remaining: Clean extraction is not fresh-machine qualification. Linux success cannot certify Windows/macOS; signed distribution requires real keys and platform tooling, not generated metadata.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Preserve prior releases, package explicit manifests and checksums, run clean extraction/verification, archive gate evidence and publish only the actual qualified platform/profile claim. Prepare native OS gate matrices and rollback procedures.

requirements.title: USL 2 Grammar and Conformance Appendix
requirements.contract: The conservative C-like grammar adds declarative blocks and requires lowering to canonical SIR, explicit supported profiles, unknown-directive rejection, invariant preservation and non-weakened proof rules.
requirements.remaining: The printed EBNF is incomplete: function/class/module/argument/letter/digit/character are undefined; expression syntax, assignment, dotted names, arrows, units and escaping are unspecified. It conflicts with the current indentation frontend; do not market a parser of the sketch as full USL2 conformance.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Turn the EBNF sketch into an explicit testable profile grammar and typed parser with source spans; define all nonterminals and every directive’s argument/field schema before native lowering. Test valid syntax, unknown directives and unresolved semantics.

requirements.title: Owner Operations Field Manual
requirements.contract: Provide install/doctor/validate/run/audit/benchmark/start/stop/status/logs/test/package through one owner surface, a local authenticated node and cross-platform launch adapters. Production-candidate and native cross-platform certification are separate labels.
requirements.remaining: Shadow/USL2 paths, OWNER.ps1 and python -m usl2 are illustrative names. ExecutionPolicy Bypass in an example is not a request to bypass current controls; Windows launch actions need a native host and explicit qualification.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Map these owner actions to the existing runtime’s actual CLI/API, preserve process ownership and localhost authentication, and provide supported-platform testing guides. Verify each command and package route before claiming it exists.

requirements.title: Glossary and Symbol Index
requirements.contract: Normalize autoplastic/CAS/causal-debt/delta/evidence/fabric/logical-worker/physical-resource/proof-obligation/residual/SIR/transformation/verified-reuse terminology. Closing note explicitly says replacing prototype directives with complete SIR nodes/native adapters remains work.
requirements.remaining: Glossary alignment is documentation, not implementation or certification. The closing note confirms the book is an engineering framework with unfinished native semantics, not evidence that all proposed features already run.
requirements.proposed_implementation: Add a stable terminology/schema mapping and glossary references to telemetry, diagnostics and backlog IDs; preserve distinctions between delta/residual, observed/predicted, logical/physical and verified/provisional.

requirements.title: Evolution / p.4
requirements.contract: Separate original books, Master v0.22 experiments, Universal Runtime Fabric and Universal Systems versions. Original chapters describe ambition, not present feature support.
requirements.remaining: Existing `legacy_sources` and prior releases preserve source lineages. Add explicit lineage IDs to report/schema metadata; never compare v0.22 and v4.x as one monotonically ordered release stream.

requirements.title: Syntax, AST, IR / pp.4–5
requirements.contract: `hello.usl` sums 1…10 to 55; `square` example sums 1²…4² to 30. Parse → link → supported type/effect checks → execute; interpreter/emitter/native bridge are separate contracts. Formats may carry serialized USL but do not thereby become executable languages.
requirements.remaining: `language.py`, `module_linker.py`, `compiler.py`, `semantic_types.py` provide identified bounded implementations. `semantic_ir_v2.py` and `semantic_translation.py` now provide real finite foreign-source IR/lowering beyond the book's historical opaque imports. Maintain explicit unsupported AST/type/effect refusals, independent program contracts and native differential tests. Do not retrofit every Part I syntax example as implemented.

requirements.title: Universality / pp.5–6
requirements.contract: 606² = **367,236 ordered address cells**; each cell requires its own compatible route/evidence. Recognition < parser sample < native/format case < scoped profile < full standard.
requirements.remaining: `catalog.py`, parser/native adapters and `completion_ledger.py` separate stages. Real Python/JS scalar-list frontends and a Ruby module exist in the developing tree; their complete language standards remain unqualified. Preserve every catalog ID, classify aliases/dialects/formats/transcripts, and qualify pairwise semantics rather than filling a Boolean matrix from labels.

requirements.title: Architecture and lanes / p.7
requirements.contract: Each work item declares dependencies, values, source fingerprint, resources, cancellation/deadline and output oracle; verified predecessors release dependent work. H0 portable interpreter, H1 native, H2 candidate comparison, H3 cooperative graph.
requirements.remaining: `server.py`, store/journal, `CooperativeScheduler`, interpreter/native routes exist. H0–H3 are conceptual route labels, not evidence that every lane supports every program. Add explicit route descriptors and effect-aware admission records. Localhost tokens/origin checks are controls; native workers remain explicitly short of an OS security sandbox.

requirements.title: Bridges / p.8
requirements.contract: Preserve typed values with specified transfer semantics; distinguish process JSON, native calls and callbacks. Book records v3.8 401 eligible probes, v4.1 289 typed transfers, v4.2 196; these are different scopes.
requirements.remaining: `polyglot_native.py`, structural ABI, callback code and native engines provide finite cases. Fourteen v4.2 catalog additions are listed below; alias variants cannot count as fourteen distinct compilers. Extend ABI tests to reentrancy, lifetimes/GC, errors, encoding, cancellation and actual calling conventions.

requirements.title: Semantics/imports / p.9
requirements.contract: Preserve negative division, Unicode representation, aliasing, truthiness and >2⁵³ precision. Certificate binds grammar/source, static/effects, ABI, observable values/errors/effects and versioned host.
requirements.remaining: Book's 40 native fixtures / 160 compatibility cells / 122 matches / 38 adaptation cases / five shim cases are historical observations. Current typed IR and compatibility helpers address an explicit scalar/list subset; closure/object/module/stdlib/concurrency coverage remains separate. Add chapter-traced semantic feature inventory and source-native versus translated-native holdouts; parser provenance never counts as native execution or general translation.

requirements.title: Workers/resources/state / pp.9–10
requirements.contract: `G=(V,E)`; `Task=(inputs,effects,cost,state,proof)`; ready iff every predecessor is verified. `P=(partial_i,dimension_j,depth_k)` is a logical coordinate. Pure deterministic checkpoints may be reused only on compatible identities; native external effects must run fresh.
requirements.remaining: `cooperative_workers.py`, `fractal.py`, `collapse.py` implement bounded DAGs, threads/processes, factoring and CAS. Book limits (40 tasks, eight threads, four processes, 20 dependencies) are historical configuration, not immutable universal requirements. Current scheduler cancellation stops pending dispatch and lets already-running tasks finish. Add measured per-worker counters and complete runtime/config/spec identity keys; do not call logical partitions additional processors.

requirements.title: Collapse/routes / pp.10–11
requirements.contract: A transform must preserve observations, effects and required trace on its declared domain. Count physically avoided work and new overhead. Compiled artifacts may be cached; native results must still be freshly checked. Exact decoding requires predictor/reference/state/residual information.
requirements.remaining: `collapse.py` offers verified byte reconstruction and serialized codec cost; `native_build_cache.py` supplies native build reuse; `adaptive.py` measures verified serial/factored candidates. Add dependency-closure/version identities, cache corruption/staleness cases and end-to-end metadata/reference costs. Pure-result reuse is a separate policy from native artifact reuse. The printed routing pseudocode is explanatory, not a drop-in executable `.usl` file.

requirements.title: Autonomy/repair / p.12
requirements.contract: `observe→diagnose→stage→authorize→atomic apply→independent tests→commit evidence OR rollback`. Model proposals do not validate themselves. Authority persists only within the authorized scope.
requirements.remaining: `entity_cycle.py` now stages experiments, checks independent cases/retention, atomically promotes versioned skills and supports rollback; it remains a finite workflow. Add robust state/transaction journals and crash/failure injection for actual project patches; never autoreplay interrupted external effects. Book's Chrome missing console observation/resume difficulties are historical integration issues requiring real host tests.

requirements.title: Platforms/integrations / pp.12–13
requirements.contract: Windows install/model lifecycle; real stdout/stderr and task observation in Chrome; actual microphones/cameras/models; GPU device+kernel+transfer+correctness+measurement; distributed node/version/backpressure/idempotency/clock/partition controls.
requirements.remaining: Sensor/device adapters, recovered Shadow/EmoVision/Chrome sources and CPU neural code exist. Model/device discovery or a health endpoint is not qualified operation. `resources.py` reads affinity/cgroup constraints and GPU discovery. Add real Windows/browser tests, installed model inference, calibrated live sensor cases and qualifying kernel/device tasks; distributed fabrics remain a separate explicit implementation/qualification track.

requirements.title: Applications / pp.13–14
requirements.contract: Software orchestrates reproducible models and experiments; products and physical hypotheses need independent domain evidence.
requirements.remaining: All ten listed application areas map below. Do not upgrade a numeric result, mockup or old discussion into a shipped product, stable isotope, novel material, battery claim or guaranteed trading outcome.

requirements.title: Formal scheduling models / pp.15–16
requirements.contract: `∀x∈D: Obs(P,x)=Obs(T(P),x)`; evidence `E=(source hash,IR hash,ABI,toolchain,D,oracle,result)`; known blockers `K−=∅` plus `K+` obligations is admission, not proof of checker completeness. `Cost=Csetup+Ccompute+Ctransfer+Cio+Cverify+Cqueue`; speedup `Tref/Tcand`; avoidance `(logical−executed)/logical`; Amdahl ceiling.
requirements.remaining: Typed IR, bounded solver/compatibility model checks and differential tests exist, with explicit unmodelled obligations. Add a structured observation schema for state/effects/errors/order and quantified domain/assumption/timeout records. Cost coefficients need consistent units and measured calibration. Canonical length-framed cache keys must include source, inputs, specification, runtime/dependencies, platform, configuration, ABI and effects; raw ambiguous concatenation is inadequate.

requirements.title: Physics/information / p.16
requirements.contract: Account for all energy sources/losses/boundaries; compression retains necessary information; numerical models require parameters, units, initial/boundary conditions and uncertainty.
requirements.remaining: The scalar equation registry computes formulas; it does not qualify quantum devices, fluids, materials, sub-Planck structures or isotope claims. Add versioned domain/unit/assumption metadata and independent solver/measurement interfaces. Keep toy, established-model, experimental-data and validated-device status separate.

requirements.title: Chronology / p.17
requirements.contract: Preserve each release's actual scope and reports. Original I/II and Master v0.22 are reference/experimental; v3.9 still zero complete specs; book v4.1 53 subsets, v4.2 67.
requirements.remaining: Keep provenance-indexed historical reports immutable. Current reports must be generated from current code and original independent acceptance contracts, not overwritten book tables. Broader source generation, ownership/GC, sandbox, Windows, browser/device and GPU qualification remain distinct obligations.

requirements.title: Archived benchmarks / pp.17–18
requirements.contract: Book v4.2: 606 IDs, 67 subsets, 539 unqualified, zero complete specs; 28/28 new cases, 490 reported regressions, 26/26 frontend checks, 196 typed transfers; 12×42=504 join; eight observed tasks. One-worker median 1332.070 ms vs eight-worker 794.274 ms, three samples, **1.6771×** for that fixture workload.
requirements.remaining: These numbers are historical book/source claims; this review did not rerun their complete historical suite. Add cold/warm raw trials, source/compiler/device fingerprints, independent holdouts, end-to-end time, peak memory, energy where measurable, spread/failures and negative results. No universal speed or Windows/model inference claim follows.

requirements.title: Completion / pp.18–19
requirements.contract: Per profile: exact normative version, grammar/AST, binding/types/effects, dynamic/numeric/Unicode/ownership/concurrency, library/host, backend/lowering, ABI, independent conformance, performance/platform, safety/license/reproducibility and independent sign-off. A tranche of ≥10 executable subsets is an objective, not ten finished standards.
requirements.remaining: The evidence ledger models 14 normative gates plus parser/native/translation/intent stages. Implement actual missing semantic chapters and standards suites; don't substitute ledger infrastructure for those implementations. Integrate host/model/sensor/GPU tasks only after their own acceptance. Continue independent work through external blockers; do not emit an all-complete handoff while gates remain pending.

requirements.title: Universal promise
requirements.contract: Use one source, transformation and execution contract per language profile; integrate `semantic_translation.py`, `completion_ledger.py`.
requirements.remaining: Compare return, streams, exit/errors, effects and committed state on admitted inputs/environments. Keywords or matching stdout alone do not establish conformance.

requirements.title: Safe `.usl` evaluation
requirements.contract: Retain AST allowlists and resource bounds in `language.py`; label supported binding/function/loop/collection scopes.
requirements.remaining: Reject imports, attributes, undefined names and unsupported syntax before effects; test adversarial time/output/memory behavior.

requirements.title: Semantic IR
requirements.contract: Adapt through `semantic_ir_v2.py`, explicit binding/type analysis and typed lowering.
requirements.remaining: Canonical schema/operator/type/numeric/profile/effect identity; original source spans and generated-operation reverse maps; roundtrip/tamper/schema-mismatch checks. CFG/SSA and exceptions require additional semantics.

requirements.title: Effects and lifetime
requirements.contract: Add conservative read/write/process/network/device/random/clock/unknown effects; native buffer ownership contract.
requirements.remaining: Reorder only nonconflicting operations; validate owned/borrowed/pinned lifetimes and callbacks with sanitizers. JSON structural types are insufficient for native memory safety.

requirements.title: Three-layer routes
requirements.contract: Keep portable, verified native, opaque foreign-host and rejection routes distinct.
requirements.remaining: Route admission requires semantic/environment/permission matches; fallback must satisfy the same requested behavior and expose its reason.

requirements.title: Collapse taxonomy
requirements.contract: Separate compression, deduplication, exact incremental update and scheduling records in `collapse.py`/workers.
requirements.remaining: Decode bytes exactly; count actual executed work and full elapsed cost independently. Metadata reuse is not a fresh native run.

requirements.title: Exact CAS
requirements.contract: Key immutable results by schema, operator, complete inputs/dependencies and relevant environment; retain provenance separately.
requirements.remaining: Corruption/missing/truncated objects fail; changing compiler, ABI or numeric/effect policy invalidates reuse. Effectful operations never silently replay.

requirements.title: Compression Success All
requirements.contract: Keep a finite approved codec tournament with decoder authority.
requirements.remaining: Include all metadata/references in size/cost; high-entropy/empty/missing-reference/decompression-bound tests; no universal-shortening claim.

requirements.title: Incremental state
requirements.contract: Implement admitted exact delta rules and dependency invalidation.
requirements.remaining: Numeric-domain/overflow identity, no-op/overlapping edits and downstream recomputation; report audit overhead and predictions separately.

requirements.title: H0–H3
requirements.contract: Namespace historical H-labels and use explicit protocol identifiers.
requirements.remaining: Every route passes reference observations before measured cost selection; no partial-stage versus full-pipeline comparison.

requirements.title: Cache economics
requirements.contract: Estimate lookup, hit validation, miss compute, eviction and maintenance costs per workload.
requirements.remaining: Cold/warm/cache-disabled paired baselines and representative hit distributions; cache value may be provenance rather than speed.

requirements.title: Parallel limits
requirements.contract: Use work/span bounds and actual measured workers in `cooperative_workers.py`/`unified_workers.py`.
requirements.remaining: Identical 1/2/4/8-worker workloads, grain-size/overhead/OS-process telemetry; logical dimensions never multiply physical cores.

requirements.title: Verified DAG joins
requirements.contract: Persist typed node inputs/results/digests and require verified predecessors.
requirements.remaining: Independent branches survive unrelated failures; consumers block; detect cycles, oversized graphs, tampered outputs and lane limits. Historical caps are version-qualified.

requirements.title: N/M factoring
requirements.contract: Partition domain exactly once; normalized resource-demand vectors and bounded recursive trees.
requirements.remaining: Coverage/no overlap, ordered or proven associative joins, skewed-load benchmarks and hard memory limits. Work-stealing/global-optimal placement remain separate features.

requirements.title: Concurrency lanes
requirements.contract: Select threads/processes/async from measured work characteristics.
requirements.remaining: Bound startup/serialization/merge; cancellation before dispatch and native process-group cleanup; never assume stopping the supervisor undoes effects.

requirements.title: CPU/GPU placement
requirements.contract: Enumerate providers, benchmark real kernels, apply capacity/correctness gates.
requirements.remaining: Warmup, synchronization, transfers, memory/thermal budgets and provider-loss fallback. GPU inventory and SwiftShader browser rendering are not GPU compute qualification.

requirements.title: Persistent learning
requirements.contract: Reuse durable `entity_memory.py`/`entity_cycle.py`, provenance and accepted skill versions.
requirements.remaining: Independent sealed holdouts, rejection/retention, corruption/migration and restart without duplicated actions. Retrieval/persistence, program synthesis and neural learning remain distinct.

requirements.title: Catalog semantics
requirements.contract: Preserve all 606 IDs, aliases, categories and separate stages in the completion ledger.
requirements.remaining: Exact unique inventory, runtime/format-specific gates and zero automatic upgrade from subset to full specification. Book's 67/539 is historical.

requirements.title: Foreign import
requirements.contract: Extend genuine typed Python/JS/Ruby profile frontends in `semantic_translation.py`/`semantic_ruby.py`.
requirements.remaining: Original runtime versus IR versus native target boundary/negative differentials; scope/capture/numeric/errors/modules explicitly supported or rejected. Parser acceptance is insufficient.

requirements.title: Matrix meaning
requirements.contract: Keep addressability, typed handoff, native subset and profile conformance distinct per edge.
requirements.remaining: 367,236 addresses default unverified; require real host/guest data/error/lifetime/callback evidence before stronger claims.

requirements.title: Full standards
requirements.contract: Normative-clause traceability per exact version/dialect/platform; upstream suites and independent boundary/metamorphic/fuzz cases.
requirements.remaining: Evaluate numbers/Unicode/aliasing/errors/effects/modules/libraries/concurrency. No finite test count proves arbitrary Turing-complete equivalence.

requirements.title: ABI/callbacks
requirements.contract: Extend `abi_types.py`/`interop.py` beyond JSON structure to a concrete native layout.
requirements.remaining: Width/sign/endian/UTF-8 lengths/strides/alignment/allocator/deleter/thread/cancel/error contracts, native callback/reentrancy fixtures and sanitizer checks per platform.

requirements.title: Bounded autonomy
requirements.contract: Use approved-plan versus proposal distinction, step validation and durable checkpoints.
requirements.remaining: Unauthorized mutation denied; pending external action after crash becomes `needs_review`; failed verification blocks dependent actions; no self-approval.

requirements.title: Agent repair
requirements.contract: Disjoint implementer/evaluator/reviewer responsibilities and finite hypothesis budgets.
requirements.remaining: New independent reproducer plus retained regressions/policy; preserve last-known-good version, negative discoveries and real tool logs. Dialogue is not evidence.

requirements.title: Shadow/Ollama
requirements.contract: Separate live model serving, history, ASR/TTS, perception, planning and execution.
requirements.remaining: Real tokens/audio references/runtime identity; report capture/load/first-token/total/playback latency and cold/warm separately. Healthy mocks do not qualify inference.

requirements.title: Chrome/desktop
requirements.contract: Exact process instance, authenticated event cursor, scoped tab/action permissions.
requirements.remaining: Actual console/browser messages, duplicate events, browser/controller crash/reconnect; logs from the controller do not prove unrelated application state.

requirements.title: EmoVision/embodiment
requirements.contract: Typed frames with identity/time/orientation/color/calibration; model hashes; signed wearable build/pairing contracts.
requirements.remaining: Actual permission denial/acquisition/model outputs and separate APK/hardware installation; emotion predictions remain uncertain estimates.

requirements.title: Windows delivery
requirements.contract: Flat reproducible source, writable state outside release, optional dependencies and rollback.
requirements.remaining: Clean Windows VM and real-device install, spaces/long paths, occupied ports, data preservation and absent-provider reduced mode. Linux evidence does not qualify Windows.

requirements.title: Scientific simulation
requirements.contract: Machine-readable experiment schema with solver/version/units/parameters/boundaries and four evidence tiers.
requirements.remaining: Algebra, numerical convergence/reference, measured predictive validity and reproduced experiment are separate gates; RK4 correctness is not new physics.

requirements.title: Materials/BEC
requirements.contract: Use established oscillator/energy models as rejection baselines.
requirements.remaining: Measured parameters, Hamiltonians/boundaries, controls and conservation; room-temperature BEC, H70, hard-light and sub-Planck claims remain research/unestablished.

requirements.title: Fluids/drones
requirements.contract: Established Reynolds/Bernoulli/Betz models with actual geometry/boundaries/actuator limits.
requirements.remaining: Conventional rotor first, matched area/power/inlet/noise, mesh convergence, wind-tunnel uncertainty and loss-of-link/sensor failures before actual flight.

requirements.title: Perception measurement
requirements.contract: Use hashed preprocessing/models and independently labelled static/live inputs, temporal uncertainty.
requirements.remaining: Full-pipeline capture→display times, no-camera/privacy-denial tests, lighting/occlusion/distribution robustness. Classifiers are model estimates, not inner-state knowledge.

requirements.title: Prediction/finance
requirements.contract: Offline chronological, leakage-free forecasts/backtests with frozen strategy and realistic costs.
requirements.remaining: Vintage/horizon/splits/baselines/rolling-origin/fees/spread/slippage/drawdown; actual fills require broker evidence. No automatic real-money permission follows.

requirements.title: Shared research platform
requirements.contract: Typed hypothesis/input/source/unit/hash/resource/reference/failure/result record.
requirements.remaining: Null hypothesis, refuting observation, heldout independence and rerunnable provenance. Negative results remain valid outputs.

requirements.title: Narrow benchmark
requirements.contract: Preserve historical samples and rerun newer workloads separately.
requirements.remaining: At least 20 randomized paired repeats when practical, absolute times/distributions/CIs, exact timer boundaries, input/tool/hardware identities and regressions.

requirements.title: Release gate
requirements.contract: Clean extraction, immutable hashes, negatives, native oracles, regressions, licenses and platform evidence.
requirements.remaining: Fail or downgrade stale evidence; show exact scope/date/unsupported APIs; no fabricated 606-complete badge.

requirements.title: Source conservation
requirements.contract: Preserve all release lines and recovered archives with checksums/licenses/adapters.
requirements.remaining: Flat extraction, state/schema migration and rollback; avoided build work and actual wall-clock gain are separate metrics.

requirements.title: Oversight/non-harm
requirements.contract: Capabilities, origin/token controls, isolated untrusted native work, secrets outside artifacts and tested abort.
requirements.remaining: Tokens/argv/loopback alone are not a sandbox; test emergency cancel/recovery, denial/rotation, network/filesystem restrictions and immutable policy.

requirements.contract: A: real semantic import; B: adapter trait with family standards; C: native ABI/ONNXCPU then actual GPU; D: real Windows acceptance.
requirements.remaining: Do not add ten labels as a quota without distinct semantics. Keep each failed external gate local to that feature; retain portable core.

requirements.contract: Measure newly verified minus invalidated claims; real workload routing preserves intent and reproducible observations.
requirements.remaining: Clean independent reproduction, admitted effects and workload-specific benefit; make missing obligations visible rather than replacing them with claims.
